quote: Compare United States v. Foster, 706 F.3d 887, 888 (7th Cir. 2013) (concluding that "[t]he Criminal Justice Act does not supply the necessary permission to pay a lawyer from the public fisc" in § 3582(c)(2) proceedings), with United States v. Guerrero, 946 F.3d 983, 985 (7th Cir. 2020) ("Foster holds that district courts are not required to appoint counsel [in § 3582(c)(2) proceedings], but it does not prohibit them from doing so.").
cite: United States v. Clarence Bonds, No. 24-1576 (7th Cir. 2024)
